title: Knowledge corpus ignores an officer's module limits for directory, merchandise, events, elections and announcements
evidence: Only finance/compliance/tasks are gated: `$showFinance = $role !== 'STUDENT' && $this->moduleAllowed($user, 'finance')`, `$showCompliance = ... moduleAllowed($user, 'compliance')`, `if ($role !== 'STUDENT' && $this->moduleAllowed($user, 'tasks'))`. The leaders block (`$showContact = $role !== 'STUDENT'`, adds `ID: %s · Email: %s`), merchandise (line 3185), events (3240), candidates (3376) and announcements (3433) run unconditionally; AccountProfile::MODULES = ['members','events','finance','tasks','merchandise','elections','compliance','announcements'].
impact: An SBO Officer whose profile is limited to e.g. ['tasks'] gets other officers' school IDs and emails (members), unpublished-election candidates and platforms (elections), stock/prices and inactive items (merchandise) and all non-draft events from a free-text semantic_rag question, plus the same rows in retrieved_rag_chunks sent to the model, though EnsureOrganizationModule blocks those pages.
suggested_fix: Gate each corpus block with moduleAllowed: leaders and contact fields on 'members', merchandise on 'merchandise', events and venues on 'events', candidates on 'elections', announcements on 'announcements'. Add AskAiAssistantTest cases per module like the existing tasks/finance ones.
verifier_notes: Real: buildKnowledgeCorpus gates only finance, compliance and tasks; moduleAllowed limits SBO_OFFICER only. Leaders (IDs, emails) and events reach an officer whose profile lacks members/events, while EnsureOrganizationModule blocks /users and /events for them. But GET /merchandise, /elections/{id}/candidates and published announcements are PARTICIPATION_ROUTES, so a limited officer may see those as a member; the leak there is member-level filtering: MerchandiseController hides inactive items from every non-ADMIN (corpus shows them to all non-students), and ElectionController::memberViewOnly applies student rules to an officer without 'elections' (corpus shows unfinalized/draft candidates).
corrected_fix: Gate leaders and contact fields on 'members' and events/venues on 'events'. For merchandise, candidates and announcements do not drop the block: apply the member view instead (is_active=true for every non-ADMIN, finalized active/closed elections when memberViewOnly, published feed with target_role filter when the officer lacks 'announcements'). Add per-module tests.

title: Leadership directory reads users.role/users.organization_id, missing every officer added through an account profile
evidence: `DB::table('users')->leftJoin('organizations', ..., 'users.organization_id')->where(fn($q) => $q->whereIn('users.organization_id', $orgIds) ...)->whereIn('users.role', ['ADMIN','SBO_OFFICER','DEPARTMENT_HEAD'])` with `users.position_title`; but memberships are created as rows in account_profiles (`$user->accountProfiles()->create(['organization_id' => $organization->id, 'role' => $data['role'], ...])` in AccountProfileController::invite, `AccountProfile::create([... 'role' => 'ADMIN' ...])` in OrganizationApplicationReviewController), and User::getRoleAttribute/getOrganizationIdAttribute only overlay the active profile on the model, not on raw DB rows.
impact: "Who is the president/treasurer of X?" misses heads approved from an application and officers invited by name (their users row keeps role STUDENT and their home organization), and still lists people whose profile in that organization was deactivated; it also contradicts buildOrganizationsWithoutAdmin, which counts admins from account_profiles.
suggested_fix: Build the directory from account_profiles joined to users (account_profiles.organization_id IN orgIds, account_profiles.role IN (...), account_profiles.account_status = 'active', users.account_status = 'active'), taking position_title from the profile.
verifier_notes: Directory queries raw users.role/users.organization_id/users.position_title; User::getRoleAttribute/getOrganizationIdAttribute overlay only the active profile on a model. AccountProfileController (add existing user) and OrganizationApplicationReviewController create account_profiles rows in other organizations, which the raw query never sees, and a deactivated non-home profile is not reflected in users.account_status.

title: Accredited organizations are never shown as accredited: corpus compares against 'complete', a status the service never returns
evidence: `'status_tone' => $org->lifecycle_status === 'active' ? ($accStatus === 'complete' ? 'success' : 'warning') : 'danger'` and `'progress_percent' => $accStatus === 'complete' ? 100 : ($accStatus === 'returned' ? 35 : 50)`; AccreditationStatusService::resolve returns only not_applicable, incomplete, returned, pending_review or accredited.
impact: Every fully accredited active organization appears with a warning tone and 50% progress, counts toward the 'Needs attention' highlight in buildSemanticRagPayload, and the chart/model are told it needs action.
suggested_fix: Compare with 'accredited' (and treat 'not_applicable' as neutral), e.g. match ($accStatus) { 'accredited' => 100, 'pending_review' => 75, 'returned' => 35, default => 50 }.
verifier_notes: AccreditationStatusService::resolve returns not_applicable|incomplete|returned|pending_review|accredited; 'complete' never occurs, so active orgs always get warning tone and 50% and count in 'Needs attention' (filter on warning/danger tones in buildSemanticRagPayload).

title: SAO and Dean corpus silently covers only the first 30 organizations and 35 leaders, while the answer claims a full search
evidence: `->orderBy('name')->limit(30)` on organizations, leaders `->orderBy('users.role')->orderBy('users.last_name')->limit(35)` (ADMIN sorts before DEPARTMENT_HEAD and SBO_OFFICER), budgets/transactions/merchandise/events/candidates/compliance `limit(25)`, while `$accreditationByOrg = $this->accreditation->forOrganizations(collect($orgIds))` is computed for every org; the copy says 'Searched %d live records across %d authorized operational domains'.
impact: For an SAO with more than 30 student organizations, any organization after the 30th alphabetically can never be found by name, deans and officers are crowded out of the directory by 35 admins, and the answer (and the model, told to say data is missing) states it searched all live records.
suggested_fix: Filter in SQL by the query's matched terms before limiting (e.g. LIKE on name/acronym for entity tokens) or raise and document the caps per domain, limit accreditation to the fetched ids, and change the copy to say how many records per domain were searched.
verifier_notes: Caps are real: organizations limit(30) ordered by name, leaders limit(35) ordered by role string (ADMIN < DEPARTMENT_HEAD < SBO_OFFICER), and accreditation is computed for all orgIds. scopedStudentOrganizationIds returns every STUDENT_ORGANIZATION for the SAO. However the copy 'Searched %d live records' uses corpus_size, the actual number fetched, so it is not a false count, only misleading about coverage.
corrected_fix: Filter in SQL by question terms before limiting (LIKE on name/acronym/person names) or raise the caps, order leaders so deans and officers are not crowded out, compute accreditation only for the fetched org ids, and say the search covered a capped sample per domain.

title: Announcements: the 'university' scope never matches, so SAO announcements are never retrievable; non-students get no audience filter
evidence: `->orWhere('announcements.target_scope', 'university')`; GlobalAnnouncementController::SCOPES = ['all_users','all_organizations','selected_organizations','all_departments','selected_departments'] and SAO announcements are stored on the SAO organization, which is outside $orgIds. The `target_role` filter is applied only `when($role === 'STUDENT', ...)`, and there is no scheduled_at/expires_at/recipients check as in AnnouncementController::visibleAnnouncement.
impact: "What did the SAO announce about accreditation?" never finds official SAO posts for any role; a Dean or SBO Officer retrieves organization announcements targeted at other roles (e.g. ADMIN-only) that their feed does not show.
suggested_fix: Mirror AnnouncementController::visibleAnnouncement: include SAO/COMPLIANCE announcements through announcement_recipients for the user, require approval_status = approved, scheduled_at <= now, expires_at > now, and apply the target_role ('all' or the user's role) filter for every role except managers viewing their own organization.
verifier_notes: 'university' is not a target_scope (GlobalAnnouncementController::SCOPES), and SAO posts sit on the SAO organization, which scopedStudentOrganizationIds excludes, so they are never retrieved; no approval_status/scheduled_at/expires_at check. The target_role leak is real for DEPARTMENT_HEAD (AnnouncementController::index applies target_role unless the user can manage), but an ADMIN or SBO_OFFICER with the announcements module sees all roles' posts on the manage page, so for them it is not a leak; it is for an officer without the announcements module.
corrected_fix: Include SAO/COMPLIANCE announcements through announcement_recipients for the user, require is_published, approval_status=approved, scheduled_at<=now, expires_at>now, and apply target_role ('all' or the user's role) except for ADMIN, and SBO_OFFICER with the announcements module.

title: Most corpus rows link to paths not in client_routes.php, so semantic answers carry no action link
evidence: hrefFor is called with '/dashboard/users' (3058), '/dashboard/finance' (3118, 3169), '/dashboard/merchandise' for students (3226), '/dashboard/events' (3276, 3305), '/dashboard/tasks' (3360), '/dashboard/announcements' (3474), '/dashboard/compliance' for DEPARTMENT_HEAD, SBO_OFFICER and STUDENT (2977, 3523), '/dashboard/elections/cast-vote' for DEPARTMENT_HEAD (3417); none of these is in that role's list in server/config/client_routes.php and ClientRouteAccess::hrefFor returns null for an unlisted path.
impact: Leaders, budgets, ledger, events, venues, tasks, announcements and most organization rows show no Open button and buildFormattedBlocks can produce no recommended_action, so the answer cannot send the user to the page where the record lives.
suggested_fix: Use real per-role paths: '/dashboard/admin/users', '/dashboard/finance/budget-allocation', '/dashboard/finance/financial-ledger', '/dashboard/merchandise/order-merchandise', '/dashboard/events/manage-events' or '/dashboard/events/activity-calendar', '/dashboard/venues', '/dashboard/tasks/task-board' or '/dashboard/tasks/assigned-tasks', '/dashboard/announcements/view-announcements', '/dashboard/department-head/compliance', '/dashboard/elections/election-results'; add a test asserting every corpus href is non-null for its role.
verifier_notes: ClientRouteAccess::hrefFor returns null for any path not in the role's list; '/dashboard/users', '/dashboard/finance', '/dashboard/events', '/dashboard/tasks', '/dashboard/announcements', '/dashboard/merchandise' are in no role's list, '/dashboard/compliance' only for ADMIN, '/dashboard/elections/cast-vote' not for DEPARTMENT_HEAD.

title: Recent queries are keyed only by school ID, so answers from one profile show under another
evidence: `AiOutput::where('requested_by', $user->school_id)->where('feature_type', 'ASK_AI_ASSISTANT')` returns prompt_text and output_text; role and organization_id come from the active AccountProfile (User::getRoleAttribute, getOrganizationIdAttribute), while school_id is the account's.
impact: A person who switches from their ADMIN profile in organization A to a member profile in organization B (or whose ADMIN profile was removed) still sees A's stored answers, which contain budget figures, officer IDs and emails, in the overview of the other profile.
suggested_fix: Filter recentQueries by organization_id = $user->organization_id and structured_input->role = $user->role (or store and filter by account_profile_id).
verifier_notes: recentQueries filters only requested_by=school_id and feature_type; ask() stores organization_id and structured_input.role, so the filter is available but unused. Overview of a different profile replays answers created under another profile's scope.

title: Full knowledge corpus is built and scored on every request, including the overview page load and deterministic topics that never use it
evidence: answer() always runs `$rag = $this->retrieveRagContext($user, $question, $organizationIds, $intent);` before the intent switch; overview() calls answer(..., 'daily_priorities', false) where augmentWithRagMatches and enhanceWithModel are both skipped. buildKnowledgeCorpus runs about 13 queries (including Budget::spentAmounts with whereDoesntHave subqueries and accreditation for all org ids), and retrieveRagContext tokenizes each of up to ~275 docs twice (`extractRawTokens($doc['search_text'])` in both loops) plus a 12-dimension substring vector per doc.
impact: Every Ask AI page open and every chip/deterministic question pays the full corpus cost (and the chat service's deterministicAnswer does it every turn), for an SAO across all organizations.
suggested_fix: Build the corpus only when intent is semantic_rag or when the model/augmentation will use it ($allowModel && $callModel), cache tokens and vectors per doc in one pass, and memoize per request.
verifier_notes: answer() calls retrieveRagContext before the intent switch; overview() uses daily_priorities with allowModel=false, so neither augmentWithRagMatches nor enhanceWithModel runs, yet the corpus is still built and scored, with rag_metadata the only consumer. Each doc is tokenized twice. The clause about the chat service's deterministicAnswer concerns the in-progress conversational work and was not verified.

title: Several suggested questions promise answers the builders do not produce
evidence: ADMIN 'Who hasn't paid collections/fees and how is our budget?' (finance_health) returns only `$unpaidInvoicesCount` and budget rows, no names; DEPARTMENT_HEAD 'Who has submitted budgets, events, or financial reports for my review?' (submitted_documents, 3842) returns only compliance submissions and financial_reports; SUPER_ADMIN 'How is university-wide budget utilization and financial report status?' (3819) gets no report status from buildFinanceHealth.
impact: The chips users are told to click cannot answer the question asked; the model is then instructed to say the data does not contain it, so the canned prompt appears broken.
suggested_fix: Reword the chips to what the builder returns, or extend the builders: list unpaid invoices with student names for ADMIN, add pending budget/event approval rows to the DH submitted view, add financial report submission status to the SAO finance answer.
verifier_notes: buildFinanceHealth for ADMIN returns only an unpaid invoice count and budget rows, no names; it has no financial report status for SAO; buildSubmittedDocuments covers compliance submissions (and reports), not budget/event submissions, as the DH chip asks.

title: Announcement guide tells SBO Officers their posts publish right away, but officer posts go to approval
evidence: Guide 'create-announcement' (roles ADMIN, SBO_OFFICER): 'Publish now or schedule it' / 'Published announcements appear on members\' feeds right away.' AnnouncementController::store: `$canPublishWithoutApproval = in_array($user->role, ['ADMIN','DEPARTMENT_HEAD'], true)`; for SBO_OFFICER `approval_status` is 'pending' and an ApprovalRequest is created.
impact: Officers following the guide expect their announcement live and are confused when it sits as pending; the step that explains approval is missing.
suggested_fix: Give SBO_OFFICER its own step text (role-keyed detail like the grievance guide's role-keyed path): 'Submit it for approval; your Admin approves it before it appears on members\' feeds.'
verifier_notes: AnnouncementController::store: canPublishWithoutApproval only for ADMIN and DEPARTMENT_HEAD; guide create-announcement includes SBO_OFFICER and says published posts appear right away.

title: Dean invitation guide says colleges are fixed and cannot be added or deleted
evidence: Summary 'The list of colleges is fixed.' and tip 'Archive a college instead of removing it. Colleges cannot be added or deleted.'; routes/api.php has POST /system/colleges (CollegeController::store) and DELETE /system/colleges/{college} (destroy) for SUPER_ADMIN.
impact: SAO users are told a capability they have does not exist, and there is no how-to for adding a college or deleting an empty one.
suggested_fix: Change the copy to 'Colleges start from a seeded list; add a college, delete an empty one, or archive one that has organizations' and add a guide for managing colleges at /dashboard/super-admin/colleges.
verifier_notes: routes/api.php has POST and DELETE /system/colleges for SUPER_ADMIN, contradicting 'The list of colleges is fixed' and 'Colleges cannot be added or deleted'.

title: Row progress for finance rows is computed from allocated minus remaining, not from spending
evidence: `if (preg_match('/Allocated:\s*₱([\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*·\s*Remaining:\s*₱([\d,]+...)/u', $secondary, ...)) { $usedPercent = (($allocated - $remaining) / $allocated) * 100;` applied to buildFinanceHealth rows ('Allocated: ₱%s · Remaining: ₱%s').
impact: A budget that received income shows 0% used even after spending, and a negative remaining ('₱-1,250.00') does not match the [\d,]+ pattern so the bar disappears; this breaks the rule that spending is summed per budget.
suggested_fix: Set progress_percent in buildFinanceHealth from Budget::spentAmounts (spent / allocated) as the corpus already does, and drop the secondary-text regex.
verifier_notes: rowProgress regex on 'Allocated · Remaining' secondary computes (allocated-remaining)/allocated; buildFinanceHealth rows have no progress_percent, so income-raised remaining clamps to 0% and a negative remaining fails [\d,]+ and yields no bar.

title: Entity boost uses substring matching, so short names match unrelated words
evidence: `if ($entityLower !== '' && strlen($entityLower) >= 3 && Str::contains(Str::lower($question), $entityLower)) { $entityBoost += 1.6; $matchedEntities[$entityTerm] = $entityTerm; }` with entity_terms including first and last names; computeSemanticVector also uses Str::contains for keywords such as 'vice', 'fee', 'hall', 'event'.
impact: A first name like 'Eve', 'Dan' or 'Ann' matches 'events', 'attendance', 'announcement', boosting unrelated people and adding a 'Related Records ... matching Dan' section through augmentWithRagMatches; 'service' triggers the leadership concept via 'vice'.
suggested_fix: Match entity terms and concept keywords on word boundaries (preg_match('/\b'.preg_quote($term,'/').'\b/u', ...)) or against the token set.
verifier_notes: Str::contains(question, entity) with a 3-char minimum: 'dan' is inside 'attendance', 'eve' inside 'events'; computeSemanticVector matches 'vice' inside 'service'.

title: Ledger rows label cash advance releases and repayments as Expense/Income
evidence: `'status' => $isExpense ? 'Expense' : 'Income'` for every transaction, while Budget::spentAmounts uses ->excludingCashAdvances() and AiInstructions says cash advances are 'never income or expense'.
impact: Ask AI lists a cash advance release as an expense next to budget rows whose Spent figure excludes it, giving contradictory money totals.
suggested_fix: Use Transaction::cashAdvanceKinds($ids) to label those rows 'Cash advance release/repayment' with a neutral tone.
verifier_notes: Ledger rows label every transaction Expense/Income by type; Transaction::cashAdvanceKinds and scopeExcludingCashAdvances exist and budget Spent excludes cash advances.

title: Highlights chart mixes pesos, counts and percentages, and drops minus signs
evidence: `$numeric = (float) preg_replace('/[^0-9.]/', '', str_replace(',', '', $rawVal));` then bars scaled to `$maxVal` across all highlights, e.g. '₱25,000.00' next to '3' invoices, '85%' next to counts, '~3 min'.
impact: Counts render as the 8% minimum next to a peso value at 100%, and a negative remaining budget is drawn as a positive bar.
suggested_fix: Only chart highlights that share a unit (add a 'unit' key when building highlights), keep the sign, and skip the chart otherwise.
verifier_notes: buildChartsForPayload strips every non-digit/dot (including '-') and scales all highlights to one max regardless of unit.

title: No-match searches still report a 78% top confidence
evidence: `$topConfidence = $topChunks !== [] ? (int) $topChunks[0]['relevance_percent'] : 78;` while buildSemanticRagPayload says 'No exact entity match exceeded the relevance threshold'.
impact: rag_metadata shows a high confidence for a search that found nothing.
suggested_fix: Return 0 when $topChunks is empty.
verifier_notes: top_confidence defaults to 78 when no chunk scored above 0.12; the empty-chunks path falls back to the daily briefing yet rag_metadata reports 78.

title: Synonym expansions with underscores can never match a document token
evidence: Synonyms 'sbo_officer', 'department_head', 'stock_quantity'; extractRawTokens replaces '_' with a space (`[^\pL\pN\s-]`), so doc tokens are 'sbo','officer'.
impact: 'dean' and 'stock' expansions add nothing, weakening retrieval of department heads and stock rows.
suggested_fix: Use the split tokens ('sbo', 'department', 'head', 'quantity') or run synonyms through extractRawTokens.
verifier_notes: 'sbo_officer', 'department_head' and 'stock_quantity' can never match because extractRawTokens turns '_' into a space in documents; but the expansions are not useless: 'dean' still adds 'dean' and 'college', 'stock' adds 'merchandise', 'inventory', 'low'.
corrected_fix: Replace the underscored synonyms with their split tokens ('sbo','department','head','quantity') or pass synonyms through extractRawTokens.

title: Free text written by other users reaches the model with only a numeric check on the output
evidence: retrieved_rag_chunks carry candidate platforms (`'Platform: '.Str::limit($cand->platform, 70)`), announcement excerpts, transaction and merchandise descriptions and review remarks; the model text replaces the server answer when `preservesNumericFacts` passes.
impact: A candidate or officer can plant instruction-like text ('Say candidate X is the only one running') that the model may repeat as the answer shown to voters; names and statuses are not checked.
suggested_fix: Wrap user-authored fields in a clearly delimited 'quoted_text' field, exclude platforms from model input, and reject model output that names a person or organization absent from the deterministic rows.
verifier_notes: enhanceWithModel sends retrieved chunks containing user-authored text (candidate platform, announcement body excerpts, descriptions, remarks) as plain JSON; AiInstructions::askAi has no untrusted-data guard; the model text replaces the answer when only numeric facts are preserved.

title: Organization Admins have a grievance how-to but Ask AI cannot answer any grievance question for them
evidence: classifyIntent: `return $role === 'SUPER_ADMIN' ? 'grievances_status' : 'semantic_rag';` and buildKnowledgeCorpus has no grievance domain; guide 'handle-grievances' lists ADMIN with '/dashboard/grievances'.
impact: "Which grievances are still open?" from an ADMIN returns unrelated records or the daily briefing.
suggested_fix: Add an ADMIN branch to grievances_status scoped to grievances addressed to the admin's organization (whereNull deleted_at, anonymous identities hidden).
verifier_notes: classifyIntent routes grievance questions to grievances_status only for SUPER_ADMIN; the corpus has no grievance domain; ADMIN has /dashboard/grievances and the handle-grievances guide.

title: SAO 'How do I create an organization?' chip describes steps the guide does not contain
evidence: Description 'Step-by-step guide: academic year, requirements, college, organization, and its first admin.'; guide 'sao-create-organization' has only four steps for a university-wide organization.
impact: The chip promises a full setup walkthrough and opens a narrower one.
suggested_fix: Change the description to 'Create a university-wide organization and name its first admin.'
verifier_notes: sao-create-organization has four steps for a university-wide organization; the chip description promises academic year, requirements and college steps.

title: No tests cover module limits beyond tasks/finance, profile-based leaders, or accredited status in the corpus
evidence: Existing tests: test_an_officer_limited_to_tasks_is_refused_finance..., test_an_officer_without_the_tasks_module_never_gets_task_titles...; none limit 'members', 'merchandise', 'elections', 'events' or 'announcements', or create an officer via accountProfiles()->create.
impact: Findings 01-03 shipped undetected.
suggested_fix: Add semantic_rag tests per module, one with an officer added through AccountProfileController::invite, and one asserting an accredited org row has status_tone success.
verifier_notes: AskAiAssistantTest limits modules only to tasks/finance/events in the existing cases, never members/merchandise/elections/announcements, never creates a membership via accountProfiles()->create in another org, and never asserts an accredited org's tone.
corrected_fix: Add tests for an officer without 'members' (no IDs/emails), without 'events' (no events), and without 'elections' (no unfinalized candidates); an officer added to a second organization through a profile appearing in that org's directory; and an accredited org row with status_tone success.
